answer: Entropy-Seeded Dynamic Challenge Rotation Agents must solve a cryptographic puzzle bound to unpredictable future block hashes, preventing precomputation of sybil clusters. The system issues a rare lotus token to nodes that pass. An attacker failing the rolling check loses a deposited sable collateral fee. Validating a single identity requires locking capital that is slashed if the response window misses the opal target threshold, making large-scale fake node creation economically unviable.
